_help: Your own names for the game world. Edit this file with any text editor (save it as UTF-8).
On the left is the name the game uses, on the right the name you want. Names are applied when a world is created and every time a career is loaded, so you can change them at any time.
Clubs can be a plain new name, or an object with any of: name, short, stadium, manager.
Players: "Old Name": "New Name" renames every player with that name. You can also rename players and clubs in the game (player card / Other Teams).
Sections starting with _ are ignored. Copy entries from _examples into the real sections to use them.
